# Microsoft Copilot Studio What's New — captured 2026-08-23
# Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/whats-new

## NO CHANGE since the 2026-08-21 capture
Newest section: **July 2026**.  ms.date **2026-08-18**, updated_at **2026-08-20**, word_count 2434.
Identical to the 2026-08-21 capture. No August 2026 section has appeared.

## July 2026 — all six items reported 2026-08-21
- **Entra Agent ID creation is now MANDATORY**: "Starting in July 2026, Copilot Studio automatically
  creates a Microsoft Entra Agent ID for every new agent, and **you can no longer opt out at the
  environment level**." (preview opt-in Nov 2025 -> default May 2026 -> mandatory Jul 2026.)
  CAVEAT: "every NEW agent" != every agent. Pre-mandate agents in opted-out environments still lack
  an Agent ID — a known-incomplete population a registry-based inventory will miss.
                                                              [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AISPM]
- **(Preview) Add a WORKFLOW or an MCP SERVER as a tool** for agents on the **GitHub Copilot
  harness**.                                                  [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AISPM]
- (Preview) **Submit an MCP server for Microsoft certification**. [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AISPM]
- (Preview) **Export environment-level agent telemetry to Azure Application Insights** via the Power
  Platform admin center.                                       [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AIDR]
- (Preview) **File attachments and agent-created files** for GitHub Copilot harness agents.
                                                              [reported 2026-08-21, held]
- Real-time agents across voice AND digital messaging (digital messaging in preview) with
  **GPT-5-Chat (Preview)**, monitored via Application Insights.  [held — extension of voice surface]

## June 2026 and earlier — unchanged
GitHub Copilot harness (production-ready preview); Microsoft IQ; skills; memory; Windows 365 for
Agents MCP server GA (full operational control of a Cloud PC — desktop interaction, browser
automation, semantic UI inspection); condition groups; Teams Phone Agent voice integration; connect
other agents (A2A); Foundry IQ connect; Claude Sonnet 5 / GPT-5.5 Chat GA. May 2026: computer use GA,
prompt node, M365 Copilot node, consent-based recording, **agent inventory schema** (admin center,
API, Azure Resource Graph), agent readiness status, async agent-flow responses, computer-use
standalone tools, Mistral Medium 3.5.
